description: Paginated grid of listing cards (image, linked title, category line, teaser, share links) that a listing-filter block can filter by category.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: filterable, paginated listing of detail pages (e.g. tourist places)

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: image cell | body cell (linked heading, a line starting with "Category" followed by comma-separated categories, teaser text) | optional footer cell with share links. 10 cards show per page; extra cards page automatically

reuseGuidance: Use for index pages listing many detail pages. Pair with listing-filter above it to filter by the Category line. For a small, static feature grid use cards instead.
